properties.displayName: [Custom] Kubernetes cluster containers should only use allowed image repositories
properties.description: Custom OPA/Rego-backed Azure Policy definition. Wraps the open-source Gatekeeper library's K8sAllowedRepos constraint template (https://github.com/open-policy-agent/gatekeeper-library/tree/master/library/general/allowedrepos) to require every container image start with one of the allowed repository prefixes.

metadata.description: 'audit' allows a non-compliant resource to be created but flags it as non-compliant. 'deny' blocks the non-compliant resource from being created. 'disabled' turns off the policy.
List of image repository prefixes a container image is allowed to start with, e.g. 'mcr.microsoft.com/' or 'docker.io/library/'.
List of Kubernetes namespaces to include in policy evaluation. An empty list means all namespaces not explicitly excluded.
List of Kubernetes namespaces to exclude from policy evaluation.
